review.answer: No - the duck pond walk planned for Friday Oct 23 at 2pm at Willow Park west entrance was postponed on Oct 14 with a raincheck and was not rescheduled.
review.reason: On Oct 12 the group set next Friday - explicitly the 23rd week - 2pm Willow Park west entrance by the duck pond. On Oct 14 in the same thread Jen says 'i cant make it friday' / 'friday is a no for me', Alex says 'honestly me too, let's just do this another day', Me says 'yeah lets just postpone then', followed by mutual 'raincheck' / 'figure it out later'. No later reschedule appears. Asked Oct 19 about 'that duck pond walk on Friday' - i.e. Oct 23 - the follow-up is still postponed.
